A '''Yammosk keeper''' was a title held by certain [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==Overview==
The keeper was a custodian who tended to the needs of a [[yammosk]] war coordinator. Their duties allowed them to telepathically connect to the powerful beasts and ensure that a commander's task was done.

==History==
The [[Priest/Legends|Priest]] [[Harrar]] had a Yammosk keeper on his personal vessel which contained a war coordinator. He confirmed with the keeper on whether the yammosk had accepted the ''[[Trickster]]''{{'s}} [[dovin basal]]s in its communication family.
